exposure.needed: whether operators run the flux image CLI commands

consequence.statement: Promoting the image CLI commands to stable changes only their maturity status; the release notes state no removal, rejection or failure, so an environment whose operator does nothing keeps working as before.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 promotes the image CLI commands to stable, and the release notes describe no removal, rename or behavior change for them.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the evidence names only 'image CLI commands' (a CLI command group) without exact command names, and no subject family covers CLI commands (cli-flag covers flags only); change: the evidence states only a maturity promotion ('promote image CLI commands to stable') without naming exact commands or stating any removal, rename, default, value or semantic change matching a change type
